newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Beijing Yanhua offers 1.01 bln H-shrs in flotation.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Yanhua offers 1.01 bln H-shrs in flotation.

text.p: Beijing Yanhua Petrochemcial Co Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 1.012 billion new H-shares, or 30 percent of its enlarged share capital, in a global offering of the company's shares.
The issue price will represent a prospective price to earnings multiple of 8.4 to 11.2 times on a fully-diluted basis, and 7.6 to 10.2 times on a weighted average basis, it said.
H-shares are Chinese enterprise shares listed in Hong Kong.
Of the total shares issued, 455.4 million shares will be offered to the U.S. market in the form of American Depositary Shares (ADS). Each ADS will represent 50 company H-shares.
Another 455.4 million shares are for international placement and 101.2 million shares are earmarked for public subscription in Hong Kong.
The company said both the U.S. offering and the international placement were in the form of ADS securities.
The petrochemical concern will grant global coordinators an option to require the company to issue up to an additional 151.8 million shares to cover over-allotment in the form of ADS.
The Hong Kong public offering will run from June 17 to June 20, and dealing in the shares in New York is expected to begin on June 24 and in Hong Kong on June 25.
The company said the issue price would be fixed on June 20.
SBC Warburg and Bear Stearns and Company Inc are the joint global co-ordinators of the issue.
Beijing Yanhua is a resins and plastics producer in China.
Net proceeds to be raised from the issue of about HK$1.12 billion to HK$1.88 billion will be used to repay outstanding bank borrowings.
The balance of the proceeds will be used to fund the company's capital expenditures for expanding existing production facilities and construction of new production facilities.
The company said the prospective dividend yield is 2.5 percent to 3.4 percent, and adjusted net tangible asset value per share is from 1.52 yuan to 1.69 yuan.
The company forecast profit after taxation and before extraordinary items of not less than 684 million yuan or HK$639 million for the year ending in December 1997.
Beijing Yanhua posted a profit of 530.5 million yuan for the year ended in December 1996, compared with 815.1 million yuan in 1995 and 178.2 million yuan in 1994.
Turnover was 5.98 billion yuan in 1996, against 6.99 billion yuan in 1995 and 3.48 billion yuan in 1994.
